description: Generate a suggested implementation plan (layout strategy, CSS primitives, repeated patterns, typography notes) from a reference screenshot. Input is an image file path.

disable_ocr.description: Skip OCR text extraction. OCR runs by default and roughly doubles latency; disable it when you don't need text content or typography (note: extract then returns empty fontSizes).

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio of the screenshot (pass 2 for a Retina/Mac capture). Auto-detected when omitted.

image_path.description: Path (absolute, or relative to the server's launch directory) to the screenshot to analyze.

name: plan
title: Generate an implementation strategy from a screenshot
